item.title: Cycle 1 · Establishing State and Probing Quantum Noise Resilience
item.description:
We initiate our durable research process by establishing baseline beliefs on state continuity and defining our first research project. Guided by recent arXiv data, we are investigating the vulnerabilities of adaptive variational quantum algorithms to hardware noise.
